description.ncbi_summary: This gene encodes a protein from the glycosyltransferase 32 family. The enzyme catalyzes the transfer of N-acetylglucosamine (GlcNAc) to core 2 branched O-glycans. It forms a unique glycan, GlcNAcalpha1-->4Galbeta-->R and is largely associated with the Golgi apparatus membrane. [provided by RefSeq, Jul 2008].

uniprot_function.text: Catalyzes the transfer of N-acetylglucosamine (GlcNAc) residues from UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine donnors to beta (1->4)-linked or beta-(1->3)-linked galactose residues on O-glycans like core 2 branched O-glycans (PubMed:10430883). Necessary for the synthesis of type III mucin which is specifically produced in the stomach, duodenum, and pancreatic duct (PubMed:10430883). May protect against inflammation-associated gastric adenocarcinomas (By similarity).
